id./param/scenario/cs/b_120_cs_070.pack|cs_: "Sorry to call you. There's something I had to tell you.
"{var:1}, did you perhaps come here seeking the divine vessel of ancient legend?
"The other day I had a dream I think was Yggdrasil's oracle.
"In the dream, {var:1} and Serena rode something large and white and landed on a strange island floating in the sky.
"But Veronica wasn't there, so I worried something had happened to her...
"I had a bad feeling, but never imagined the dream would come true at such a time.
"Yet the scene in the dream reminded me of a passage from a myth.
"Cetacea... A divine being who soars through the skies, descending to the Luminary, guided by a holy melody.
"The sky island in the dream must be where the Luminary should go. And leading there is the divine messenger, Cetacea.
"I'm turning the village's old documents inside out to research Cetacea. I'll report if I learn anything.
"...You must be tired today. I've arranged an inn for you, so please rest there for now."
